q2.preprocessing: Median imputation, scaling, and category vocabulary fitted on training data only.
q2.meeting_count_interpretation: Meeting count is shared by both players; it is not a directional advantage. Orientation is fixed by player ID.

paired_brier_comparison.limitation: Pair-cluster resampling does not capture every shared-player dependence across different pairs.

q2.primary_metric: Brier score (lower is better). All three models are evaluated on exactly the same held-out matches.
q2.test_history_policy: Earlier held-out results can update later held-out pre-match histories; model parameters stay frozen.

q3.status: Q3 within-player adjusted model fitted with explicit inference warnings.
warnings: Legacy player-by-match covariance has negative coefficient variance(s); affected intervals are unavailable. Primary dyadic covariance clusters through either participant.

Dyadic intervals assume no residual dependence between disjoint player pairs; tournament-wide shocks and indirect network dependence may remain. Tournament-only sensitivity does not address serial player dependence.
Left-handed subgroup support is smaller; asymptotic intervals and the exposure-based deletion checks do not establish uniform effects across players.
q3.covariance: Primary shared-player dyadic sandwich, preserving repeat dyads and both physical-match views; no clipping or absolute-value variance repair.
q3.ci_note: Exploratory normal 95% intervals; (n-1)/(n-player_intercepts-within_rank) finite-sample scaling includes absorbed fixed effects.
q3.interpretation: Adjusted opponent L-minus-R probability contrasts are reported separately by focal hand in percentage points. L uses the coefficient sum and full covariance.

chronology.screening_rule: Distinct events for a known player: start gap 1–6 days, or 7–13 days after a G start.
chronology.interpretation: Potential overlaps unresolved without match dates; early exits or ordinary calendar differences may explain candidates. No event end dates were imputed and this diagnostic does not change eligibility.

spot_checks.scope: Automated local source/history consistency only; no independent external verification or human review.
